plain: The answer key saying, for each fact and task, whether the fact should be shared or held back.
eli5: A sticker on each secret saying "OK to tell the doctor" or "do not tell".
technical: CIMemories' per attribute-task ground truth, marking an attribute necessary or inappropriate to share; labels come from GPT-5 role-playing three Westin personas, and only pairs where all agree are kept, so ambiguous pairs are left out of both metrics.
